title: Niagara Falls: Journey Behind the Falls, and Tower Walking Tour
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Discover the majesty of Niagara Falls on this intimate small-group tour, perfect for those seeking a more personalized experience. Start your adventure at Skylon Tower, soaring 520 feet up for breathtaking views of Bridal Veil, Horseshoe, and American Falls. Then, head 125 feet below ground to Journey Behind the Falls for an up-close encounter with the roaring waters. With a maximum of 12 guests, enjoy the insights of a local English-speaking guide and the convenience of included attraction entry fees. This unforgettable experience lasts 2 hours, ensuring you soak in the wonder of one of nature's greatest spectacles. This is a small group tour limited to 12 participants for a personal experience. Includes all attraction entry fees with no hidden costs. Enjoy stunning panoramic views from Skylon Tower and immerse yourself in the power of the Falls at Journey Behind the Falls
